final_generalization_requirement: A fresh frozen holdout or pre-specified grouped/nested combinatorial evaluation must be created before any interaction-support repair is trained.
future_dataset_design_rule: Every policy-relevant primitive and engineered interaction intended to be learned must have nonzero training support; OOD should withhold novel combinations, not all positive evidence for the governing interaction.
